definitions.explanation: To give one's all to someone or something.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}のために{尽|つ}くす。
examples.english: To devote oneself to one's family.

notes:
{尽|つ}くす means to exhaust completely or to devote oneself wholeheartedly.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {尽|つ}きる (intransitive, to be exhausted)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {力|ちから}を{尽|つ}くす: to exert all one's effort
- {手|て}を{尽|つ}くす: to try every means
- {全力|ぜんりょく}を{尽|つ}くす: to give one's all
- {人|ひと}に{尽|つ}くす: to devote oneself to someone

AUXILIARY USE:
Verb stem + {尽|つ}くす means "to do completely":
- {言|い}い{尽|つ}くす: to say everything
- {使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす: to use up completely

RELATED:
- {尽|つ}きる: to run out, be exhausted
